content:
The image shows two coffee leaves with circular brown lesions surrounded by yellow halos. The lesions have a characteristic "eye" appearance — tan/brown center with a darker brown ring and a yellow chlorotic halo. This is the textbook presentation of Brown Eye Spot (Cercospora coffeicola) on coffee.
